darkChat.name: Dark Theme Chat Cards
darkChat.hint: Recolours the default Draw Steel chat cards, buttons and embeds to match the Foundry dark theme.

compactAbilities.name: Compact Ability Details
compactAbilities.hint: Lay an ability’s details out the way the book does: keywords and action type on one bold row, distance and target beneath. Drops the Keywords and Type labels and shrinks the text to fit. Per client.

collapsibleAbilities.name: Click Ability Name to Collapse
collapsibleAbilities.hint: Clicking the name of an ability in chat collapses the card down to just its name. Remembered between reloads.

flexButtons.name: Full Width Chat Buttons
flexButtons.hint: Chat card buttons fill the width of the message, sharing a row when two or three fit, and always using the fewest rows with the most even split.

powerRollResults.name: Collapsible Power Roll Results
powerRollResults.hint: Replace the "Power Roll + Characteristic" line with a Power Roll Results toggle holding the dice, the bonus and the tier list. Starts closed and remembers. Per client.

turnMarkers.name: Mark Where Turns Start and End
turnMarkers.hint: Rule off each turn, each round and each encounter in chat, with the name of whoever is acting stroked in their own colour and their token beside it, which you can click to ping. Anything finished folds away to a single line you can click to open again, and whatever is still going always stays open.

speakerPicker.name: Speaking As Row
speakerPicker.hint: A row above the chat buttons shows who your messages come from: your selected token, or you when nothing is selected. Click it to speak as yourself or another character.

compactSpeech.name: Compact Chat Messages
compactSpeech.hint: Typed messages fit on one line: the speaker's portrait, their name, and what they said. Emotes appear in italics.

mentionNames.name: Highlight Names
mentionNames.hint: When a typed message names a character or a player, their name is bolded with their portrait in front. Click the portrait to find their token.

blendSpeech.name: Join Back-to-Back Messages
blendSpeech.hint: When the same speaker sends several messages in a row, only the first shows their name and portrait.

notice.olderCombatTools: Draw Steel: Combat Tools {version} still posts its own Combat Round Log and Combat Turn Log, so Battle Log's turn markers are off to avoid logging every turn twice. Update Combat Tools, or turn those logs off under its Combat Logs settings, and reload.

Speech.changeTooltip: Choose who your messages come from
